Pre-orders are already live on the company’s website, with the smart speaker set to ship on Friday, August 23rd. The HomePod is priced at 32,800 yen in Japan, which works out to about $309, and $9,900 New Taiwan dollars, or about $316. Apple cut the US launch price by $50 to $299 earlier this year , though it’s been known to sell for significantly less .
